answer: A workable defense is bonded registration: every agent must lock a refundable copper-denominated stake before it can transact, and the stake is slashed if peers prove duplicate or coordinated fake identities. A single sparrow-weight account gains little, because influence grows only from sustained, audited work, not from sheer account count. Each verified job issues a non-transferable opal credential that decays without continued honest service, so an attacker must pay real capital and ongoing effort for every fake identity, while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
